worked.problem: A learner transforms triangle A(-1, -1), B(2, -1), C(-1, 1) by reflection in the x-axis but changes only the x-coordinate of B. Identify the first error and give the correct image.
actions: Plot and label the original vertices A(-1, -1), B(2, -1), C(-1, 1) on one fixed set of axes.
First error: changing only B’s x-coordinate does not apply reflection in the x-axis to every vertex. Keep x; reverse the sign of y for every vertex.
Map A (-1, -1) to A′(-1, 1); retain A and A′.
Map B (2, -1) to B′(2, 1) and C (-1, 1) to C′(-1, -1); join A′B′C′.
Check the coordinate rule on all three vertices; image A′(-1, 1), B′(2, 1), C′(-1, -1).
worked.answer: reflection in the x-axis; A′(-1, 1), B′(2, 1), C′(-1, -1)
worked.check: Check the coordinate rule on all three vertices; image A′(-1, 1), B′(2, 1), C′(-1, -1).
worked.misconception: Apply the same rule to both coordinates of every vertex; check the centre, axis and scale.
